title: perworld L v2 light criterion spec (signable draft)

items: O1: section 2.3 encoding corrected to actual reference encoding (per-world keys rgb_w{k}_cam0 / depth_w{k}_cam0 / seg_w{k}_cam0; state.npz stacked on nworld leading dim)
O4: section 2.2 recipe split - only parameters block verbatim equal; scene_xml/script sha256/bytes necessarily change
O5: section 10.2 guard count made explicit (new exe = 1; new inputs <= 12 with 9 mandatory) and final count per window freeze list
O2: section 11.1 precondition - capture script must write command; captured_at must come from explicit non-empty MJWARP_CAPTURE_AT
O3: section 11.1 precondition - per_world_scope wording must be updated before capture; recipe.task_id old-card-id handled via task_id parameterization or reference_tag
revisions.unchanged: criteria semantics, thresholds 384/576, failure conditions, criterion v2.2 non-inheritance, fact base (spot=0), non-claim

per_world_light_facts.spot_note: spot pos=(0,0,2)/dir=(0,0,-1) lies on tri_body z-rotation axis; zero under hinge rotation (scene geometry fact, not a defect)

criteria.light_fields: state.npz light_xpos/light_xdir bit-level equal per world (f32 bit patterns, zero exceptions)

inter_world_discriminability.definition: adjacent worlds (0->1, 1->2): depth bit-changed pixels and seg pair-changed pixels

bands.[384,576): insufficient margin -> collection fails, stop and report

criteria.criterion_v2_2_inheritance: NONE; v2.2 allowlists (183px / 172px, |ULP|<=128) serve only the 10 legacy regression entities and are untouched

preconditions_collection_window: capture script must write command field (currently absent) and it must be non-empty after capture
captured_at must be produced from an explicitly set non-empty MJWARP_CAPTURE_AT (existing reference has empty string); verify env before window
per_world_scope wording must be updated from the old 'does_not_cover: per-world light poses' text to the new coverage statement
recipe.task_id old-card-id handled: parameterize task_id or add reference_tag; record before/after in collection evidence
signatures_required: S-1 spec sha256+bytes (this file's spec.sha256/bytes, v2)
S-2 collection window plan (user dual-sign: plan + baseline + signed floor + authoring exception pre-approval) plus the four preconditions above
S-3 validation window plan (user dual-sign) + Chief token
non_claim: draft only; not effective until the user signs
not a per-world L v2 start
no performance or rendering-value conclusions claimed
spot has zero discriminability; only sun/lamp are discriminable in this reference
